title: Invoice
description: The invoice's header: who bills whom, when, and on what terms.

number.title: Invoice number
number.description: The invoice's identifier, as the seller numbers invoices.

issue_date.title: Issue date
issue_date.description: The date the invoice is issued, YYYY-MM-DD.

due_date.title: Due date
due_date.description: The date payment is due, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit it when the payment terms say instead.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency every amount is in, such as USD or EUR. Amounts are printed with two decimal places.

tax_rate.title: Tax rate (percent)
tax_rate.description: The tax charged on the subtotal, as a percentage: 8.25 for 8.25%. 0, the default, prints no tax line.

tax_label.title: Tax label
tax_label.description: What the tax is called on the invoice, such as VAT or Sales tax.

seller.title: Seller
seller.description: Who issues the invoice and is paid.

bill_to.title: Bill to
bill_to.description: Who the invoice is addressed to and who pays it.

payment_terms.title: Payment terms
payment_terms.description: How and when to pay, such as "Net 30, by bank transfer". Line breaks are kept.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Anything else printed at the foot of the invoice. Line breaks are kept.

address.title: Address
address.description: The postal address, one line per line of the address.

tax_id.title: Tax ID
tax_id.description: A VAT or other tax registration number, printed as given.
